name: Automation / Test Defects
messageRegex: (?s).*(locator not found|element not found|strict mode violation|selector|detached (element|node)|resolved to .* elements|automation script|test framework|beforeEach|afterEach|fixture error).*

name: API / Integration Issues
messageRegex: (?s).*(HTTP ?(400|401|403|404|409|500|502|503|504)|status( code)? (400|401|403|404|409|500|502|503|504)|Received: ?(400|401|403|404|409|500|502|503|504)|API failure|API request failed|JSON schema|schema mismatch|integration failure|service failure).*

name: Environment / Infrastructure Issues
messageRegex: (?s).*(ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|ENOTFOUND|ETIMEDOUT|network error|net::ERR|server unavailable|database connection|browser (crash|closed)|browser has been closed|target page.*closed|test environment unavailable|fetch failed|socket hang up).*

name: Test Data Issues
messageRegex: (?s).*(test data (missing|not found|unavailable)|customer.*not found|account.*not found|invalid test data|duplicate data|required data unavailable).*

name: Timeout / Performance Issues
messageRegex: (?s).*(TimeoutError|timeout|timed out|slow response|performance threshold|navigation timeout|API timeout|waiting timeout).*
